current_stances.position: Ubique reinforces its view that specific physical gestures—such as firm mouth closure, head protrusion, and postural adjustment during intense emotional states—reflect evolutionary adaptations linked to physical preparation, exertion, and social signaling.
Ubique reinforces its view that tear secretion during emotional crying involves coordinated autonomic and mechanical pathways.
